parts:
Hi,

my app is host on a pro version of shiny server.

I use shinydashboard to create a basic app, the log in works fine, but I can't find a way to log out easily from inside the app.
currently, the only way to log out is to wait the end of the authentication duration or to close the browser and delete manually the credentials (when they are automatically kept)

I know the log out button is automatical when using classical shiny app. But It does not seems to be the case for shinydashboard.
is there some way to code a log out procedure?

best,
